title: Date, time & language
blurb: Wrong clock, time zone, date format, language.

remedies.title: Clock or date is wrong
remedies.why: Automatic time is off, the time zone is wrong, or the sync with the time server failed. A wrong clock breaks sign-ins and secure websites.

steps.text: Sync the clock with the internet time server now.
Turn on "Set time automatically" and "Set time zone automatically".
Turn on "Set time and date automatically" and "Set time zone automatically".
If the clock resets every time the computer is unplugged (desktops), its small motherboard battery is flat.

remedies.title: Dates show in the wrong format (day/month vs month/day)
remedies.why: Date, number and currency formats follow the region setting.

steps.text: Settings › Time & language › Language & region › Regional format.
System Settings › General › Language & Region › Region and Date format.
Excel uses the region too; restart Excel after changing it.

remedies.title: Change the language of the computer
remedies.why: The system's display language is separate from the keyboard layout and the region.

steps.text: Settings › Time & language › Language & region › Add a language › tick "Set as my Windows display language"; sign out to finish.
System Settings › General › Language & Region › add the language and drag it to the top; restart apps.
A single app can use its own language (Mac: Language & Region › Applications).
